name: Landgasthof Linde
beschreibung: Landgasthof Linde in Stumm in the Zillertal Valley cherishes a hospitality heritage spanning over 500 years, standing out as one of Tyrol's most celebrated historic gourmet addresses. This 4-star boutique inn pairs heritage timber architecture with contemporary luxury and understated elegance. Individually designed rooms and suites provide a serene sanctuary. Highlights include an idyllic orchard garden featuring a natural swimming pond alongside a tranquil wellness spa with saunas. Awarded Gault&Millau toques, the renowned restaurant crafts inventive gastronomy from estate-grown and organic regional produce. Ski arenas such as Hochzillertal and the Zillertal Arena are just minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Historic 4-star boutique country inn in Stumm in the Zillertal Valley featuring award-winning dining and SPA.
